assays.assay_name: Group Foraging Task (competitive corridor, incl. solitary foraging control)
assays.assay_description: Four co-housed rats compete serially for access to a single-occupancy food chamber reached through a one-rat-wide tubular corridor from a waiting chamber; 5 consecutive daily sessions (each ≤5 min), followed on day 6 by solitary foraging in the same apparatus. Measures: corridor entry latency, food-chamber occupancy, push success rate, pellet consumption and the derived competitive avoidance (CA) index. Variants include adolescent-exposed, adult-exposed and saline-only cohorts and bidirectional chemogenetic (hM3Dq/hM4Di + CNO) manipulation of the vHPC→OFC projection.

application_type.evidence: 25C-NBOMe ... administered intraperitoneally at a dosage of 0.1 mg kg-1; CNO (5.0 mg kg-1, intraperitoneal) 30 minutes before each behavioral test.

setup_habituation.evidence: Prior to the daily training sessions, the rats were given 30 minutes of free exploration to familiarize themselves with the apparatus.

setup_restrain.evidence: four co-housed rats in the waiting chamber, upon the shutter opening, would traverse the tubular corridor and enter the food chamber

food_restriction.evidence: During the foraging task (6 days), food was restricted to 20 g of standard chow per rat per day (food pellets were present inside the food chamber during the session).

water_restriction.evidence: Rats received food and water ad libitum except during specified experimental procedures; no water source is described in the foraging apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: Drug exposure PND 35-48; After group foraging (PND 65-70) ... behaviour quantified in adulthood.

sample_size.evidence: Group 1: clusters 'predominantly composed of saline-treated rats (13 of 14)' and '25C-NBOMe-treated rats (11 of 14)'; group 2 n = 40 and group 3 n = 28 were run through the same paradigm.

outcomes.summary: On day 5, rats exposed to 25C-NBOMe during adolescence showed longer corridor entry latency, shorter food-chamber occupancy, lower push success rate, reduced pellet consumption and a higher competitive avoidance index than their saline cage mates; no differences appeared during solitary foraging, and adult exposure produced no effect. Chemogenetic activation of the vHPC→OFC projection in drug-exposed rats, or inhibition in saline controls, abolished the group differences.
outcomes.statistics: Day × drug exposure interactions (repeated-measures LMM): latency F1,26=12.038, P=0.002; occupancy F1,26=11.016, P=0.003; push success F1,26=6.522, P=0.029; pellet consumption F1,26=15.584, P=0.001; CA index F1,52=32.525, P<0.001. Solitary foraging: U=83, P=0.511; t26=0.095, P=0.92. Clustering vs treatment: Yates-corrected χ2=11.81, df=1, P<0.001. Adult exposure: CA index days F1,26<0.01, P>0.99; drug F1,26=0.556, P=0.463; interaction F1,26=0.332, P=0.569. Chemogenetics: drug × CNO interactions latency F1,28=6.177, P=0.019; occupancy F1,14=5.531, P=0.034; CA index F1,28=8.964, P=0.006; hM4Di: χ2(1)=10.667, P=0.001; occupancy F1,14=6.346, P=0.025; CA index F1,13.33=13.958, P=0.002.
outcomes.evidence: On day 5 of group foraging training, adolescent 25C-NBOMe-exposed rats displayed a longer entry latency into the corridor ... shorter occupancy time in the food chamber ... lower push success rate ... and reduced food pellet consumption compared to their saline counterparts.

judge_notes: Merged the solitary-foraging control (day 6, same corridor apparatus, same latency/occupancy measures) into the Group Foraging Task entry, following 2/3 candidates; it is the same apparatus and measures under a different social condition and is reported as part of the same paradigm. Noted in assay_description and D3 (6 recording days).

Chemogenetic (hM3Dq/hM4Di + CNO) and CNO-only control foraging experiments were folded into the single Group Foraging assay per the rubric's 'same test under optogenetic/chemogenetic manipulation = 1 assay' rule.
Excluded all in vivo multisite LFP/coherence recordings, in vitro slice electrophysiology, histology and viral-expression validation as non-behavioural.
B1 for Group Foraging corrected to 2 points (4-6 measures); gemma assigned 3 points with the '4-6' label, which is inconsistent with the rubric.
